title: Black Mooring
shortDescription: A tarred post where the captain keeps the best boat.
longDescription:
A tarred post, a good boat, and room for a coat. The captain prefers the camp west of here. The mill-race is north. The cargo hollow is west.
This is the end of the south bank. The wood beyond is not this errand.

fixtures.name: Tarred Post
fixtures.lookDescription: A post painted with tar. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: The tar is fresh. A Collegium skiff could live here and look like a thief's boat until you know Marram's knot. The captain kept the best painter for himself. Marram wants the post ordinary again.
